question: Which carrier delivers fastest on average?
before_sql: SELECT carrier, AVG(DATEDIFF(delivered_date, shipped_date)) AS average_days FROM shipments GROUP BY carrier ORDER BY average_days
before_error: function datediff(timestamp with time zone, timestamp with time zone) does not exist
after_sql: SELECT carrier, AVG(EXTRACT(DAY FROM (delivered_date - shipped_date))) AS average_days FROM shipments GROUP BY carrier ORDER BY average_days

question: Show stock that needs reordering.
before_sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, warehouse_id, quantity_on_hand FROM inventory JOIN products ON inventory.product_id = products.product_id WHERE quantity_on_hand <= reorder_level
after_sql: SELECT i.product_id, p.product_name, i.warehouse_id, i.quantity_on_hand FROM inventory i JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id WHERE i.quantity_on_hand <= i.reorder_level

question: How full is each warehouse relative to its capacity?
before_sql: SELECT warehouse_id, warehouse_name, SUM(quantity_on_hand) AS total_stock, capacity_units, SUM(quantity_on_hand) * 100.0 / capacity_units AS utilization FROM inventory JOIN warehouses ON inventory.warehouse_id = warehouses.warehouse_id GROUP BY warehouse_id, warehouse_name, capacity_units ORDER BY utilization DESC
after_sql: SELECT i.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, SUM(i.quantity_on_hand) AS total_stock, w.capacity_units, SUM(i.quantity_on_hand) * 100.0 / w.capacity_units AS utilization FROM inventory i JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id GROUP BY i.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, w.capacity_units ORDER BY utilization DESC

question: Show warehouse utilisation as a percentage of capacity.
before_sql: SELECT warehouse_id, warehouse_name, (SUM(quantity_on_hand) / capacity_units) * 100 AS utilization_percent FROM inventory JOIN warehouses ON inventory.warehouse_id = warehouses.warehouse_id GROUP BY warehouse_id, warehouse_name ORDER BY utilization_percent DESC
after_sql: SELECT i.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, (SUM(i.quantity_on_hand) / w.capacity_units) * 100 AS utilization_percent FROM inventory i JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id GROUP BY i.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name ORDER BY utilization_percent DESC
after_error: column "w.capacity_units" must appear in the GROUP BY clause or be used in an aggregate function

after_sql: SELECT i.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, SUM(i.quantity_on_hand) AS total_stock, w.capacity_units FROM inventory i JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id GROUP BY i.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, w.capacity_units ORDER BY total_stock DESC

question: How many days on average pass between an order and its payment?
before_sql: SELECT AVG(DATEDIFF('day', o.order_date, p.payment_date)) AS average_days FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id

after_sql: SELECT AVG(JULIANDAY(p.payment_date) - JULIANDAY(o.order_date)) AS average_days FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
